# Canonical file reference

One page per canonical kind, generated from the JSON Schemas that `agent-team schema export` writes.
`agent-team validate` checks every file under `canonical/` (and `routing/registry.yaml` beside it) against these.

| Kind | Files | Page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` | `canonical/agents/*.md` | [agent.md](agent.md) |
| `skill` | `canonical/skills/*/SKILL.md` | [skill.md](skill.md) |
| `workflow` | `canonical/workflows/*.yaml` | [workflow.md](workflow.md) |
| `tool` | `canonical/tools/*.yaml` | [tool.md](tool.md) |
| `policy` | `canonical/policies/*.yaml` | [policy.md](policy.md) |
| `environment` | `canonical/environments/*.yaml` | [environment.md](environment.md) |
| `registry` | `routing/registry.yaml` | [registry.md](registry.md) |
